MISSION VIEJO AGENDA
  City Council, Community Development Financing Authority,
  Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency,
  Housing Authority, and Library Board of Trustees*
  June 25, 2024, at 5:00 PM (Closed Session Business)
  June 25, 2024, at 6:00 PM (General Business)
City Hall, 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California, 92691  City Council Chamber

CALL TO ORDER—CITY COUNCIL, COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT FINANCING
AUTHORITY, SUCCESSOR AGENCY OF THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT AGENCY,
HOUSING AUTHORITY, AND LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES

*Note: All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title “Council Member.”

ROLL CALL:  Council Member Bucknum
  Council Member Goodell
  Council Member Vasquez
  Mayor Pro Tem Ruesch
  Mayor Kelley

  CLOSED SESSION

  CS1.  Public Employment/Appointment Position: Assistant City Manager/Director of Public
  Services

  CS2.  Conference with Real Property Negotiators (i) Property: CVS - 25272 Marguerite
  Parkway, Mission Viejo, CA 92692, (ii) Agency Negotiators: City Manager Dennis
  Wilberg, Assistant City Manager Keith Rattay, Director of Community Development
  Elaine Lister, City Attorney William P. Curley, (iii) Negotiating Parties: The Robert
  Victor Zakari Living Trust, (iv) Under Negotiation: Price and terms Relating to
  Interests in Real Property Including, but not Limited to Imposition of Bylaws;
  Covenants, Codes and Conditions; Mutual Easements, Licenses and Limited Duration
  Use Covenants: Lease Hold Interests, Purchase, Sale for Conditional Disposition,
  Grants of Rights-Of-Way, Individual Easements and the Possible Purchase, Sale,
  Exchange or Gifting of the Same by and Between the Parties.

  REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

  INVOCATION: Council Member Goodell

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Pro Tem Ruesch

  PRESENTATIONS
City Council Agenda  1  June 25, 2024
   P1.  Adopted Headquarters Battalion of the 1st Marine Division Quarterly Recognition

  Recommended Action: Present certificates of commendation to the "Marine of the Quarter"
  Lance Corporal Vanessa Esquivel, and "Noncommissioned Officers of the Quarter" Corporal
  Jake R. Danieli.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS
  Please see the City Clerk to make your request to speak. When addressing the City Council, state your
  name for the official record. If presenting handout materials for the City Council, please provide six
  copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Your materials will become public record.

  NON-AGENDA ITEMS: You may address the City Council on matters NOT listed on the agenda
  during “Public Comments.” You will be allotted up to three (3) minutes to speak on any item in the
  City’s subject matter jurisdiction that is not already scheduled for discussion. Under the Ralph M.
  Brown Act, the City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment but may respond briefly
  to statements made or questions posed, request clarification or refer the item to staff.

  AGENDA ITEMS: If you wish to address the Council on an item that is listed on the agenda, please
  make your request to speak before the Mayor announces that agenda item. When the matter is being
  considered, you may address the City Council after being recognized by the Mayor or Mayor Pro Tem.
  You will be allotted up to three (3) minutes to speak, and your remarks should be limited to the
  discussion of that specific agenda item.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

  1.  City Council Minutes

  Recommended Action: Approve the Minutes for the regular City Council Meeting of June
  11, 2024, as presented or as amended.

  2.  General Check Register Dated May 31, 2024 in the Amount of $914,009.46

  Recommended Action: Ratify the accompanying check register.

  3.  General Check Register Dated June 7, 2024 in the Amount of $2,138,390.40

  Recommended Action: Ratify the accompanying check register.

  4.  Golf Check Register Dated May 31, 2024 in the Amount of $5,814.12

  Recommended Action: Ratify the accompanying check register.

  5.  Golf Check Register Dated June 7, 2024 in the Amount of $4,704.95

  Recommended Action: Ratify the accompanying check register.

  6.  Mission Viejo Housing Authority Budget - Fiscal Year 2024/25

City Council Agenda  2  June 25, 2024
   Recommended Action: Adopt Housing Authority Resolution 24-XX Adopting a Budget for
  FY 2024/25.

  7.  Mission Viejo Community Development Financing Authority Budget - Fiscal Year
  2024/25

  Recommended Action: Adopt CDFA Resolution 24-XX, Adopting a Budget for the 2024/25
  Fiscal Year.

  8.  Microsoft On-Premise Licensing Renewal

  Recommended Action: Approve 3-year renewal of Microsoft on-premise licensing and
  issuance of purchase orders to reseller CDW-G each year of the term, for a total amount not
  to exceed $144,170 over the 3-year term.

  9.  Development Code Amendment P-DCA2024-0001 to Title 9 of the Mission Viejo
  Municipal Code to Establish Inclusionary Hosing Requirements as Referenced in the
  Housing Plan of the Mission Viejo 6th Cycle (2021-2029) Housing Element

  Recommended Action: Adopt Ordinance 24-353 Approving Development Code Amendment
  P-DCA2024-0001, Amending Title 9 of the Mission Viejo Municipal Code to Establish
  Inclusionary Hosing Requirements as Referenced in the Housing Plan of the Mission Viejo
  6th Cycle (2021-2029) Housing Element

  10.  Professional Services Consultant Team

  Recommended Action: (1) Approve the Professional Services Consultant Team Roster (for
  plan check/design or other professional services); (2) authorize the City Manager to execute
  contracts with members of the Professional Services Consultant Team as needed; (3)
  authorize the City Manager to add consultants to the Professional Services Consultant Team
  Roster as needed during the contract term.

  11.  Age Well Senior Services Inc. Contract for Senior Mobility Program

  Recommended Action: Approve First Amendment for Agewell Senior Services Agreement
  for the Senior Mobility Program

  12.  Establish an Appropriations Limit for the 2024-25 Fiscal Year

  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 24-XX Establishing an Appropriations Limit for
  the 2024-25 Fiscal Year.

  13.  Mission Viejo Trash and Runoff Abatement Project (TRAP): Catch Basin Debris
  Screen and Automated Retractable Screen Installations in the North El Toro Area (CIP
  24256)

  Recommended Action: (1) Certify the completion of and accept the improvements for the
  subject project; (2) authorize the City Manager to sign the Notice of Completion; (3) authorize
  the City Clerk to record the Notice of Completion with the County of Orange and to release
  the faithful performance and payment bonds one year and 35 days, respectively, after the date
City Council Agenda  3  June 25, 2024
   of recordation of the Notice of Completion contingent upon no claims or liens being filed
  with the City; and (4) authorize the release of the final retention 35 days after the date of
  recordation of the Notice of Completion.

  14.  Maintenance Of Traffic Signals and Appurtenance, Interconnect, Battery Back-Up
  Systems, Illuminated Street Name Signs, Safety Lights, CCTV Cameras, Speed
  Feedback Signs and Illuminated Crosswalk Services - First Contract Amendment

  Recommended Action: Approve Contract Amendment #1 in the amount of $66,000 to
  Contract A23-26 with Bear Electrical Solutions, Inc. for traffic signal maintenance services.

  15.  Technical Services Outsourcing for Mission Viejo Library

  Recommended Action: Approve Agreement with Ingram Library Services, LLC for
  Customized Library Services in an amount not to exceed $200,000 per year for the provision
  of electronic selection lists, electronic ordering, acquisitions, cataloging, and physical
  processing of library materials, pending approval of the 2024-25 budget by the City Council.

  16.  Graffiti Removal, Steam Cleaning, Painting and Sealing Services – Bonanza Steam
  Cleaning, Inc.

  Recommended Action: (1) Approve Tenth Amendment to the existing maintenance contract
  with Bonanza Steam Cleaning, Inc for the subject services; and (2) authorize a Change Order
  to the existing Purchase Order for Bonanza Steam Cleaning, Inc. in an amount not to exceed
  $15,000.00.

  17.  Annual Routine Playground, Parkland, and Facility Infrastructure Maintenance and
  Repairs

  Recommended Action: (1) Approve Fifth Amendment to the existing maintenance contract
  with Jamey Clark, Inc for the subject services; and (2) authorize a Change Order to the
  existing Purchase Order for Jamey Clark, Inc. in an amount not to exceed $40,000.00.

  18.  Copier Equipment Replacement

  Recommended Action: Authorize the City Manager to enter into a 60-month lease agreement
  with Konica Minolta Premier Finance on behalf of the City Council with a lease payment of
  $1,483.84 per month for a total of $89,030.40 over the five-year term, additional service
  charges are locked at $0.0045 for black/white copies and $0.030 for color copies for the term
  of this contract agreement.

  ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

  NEW BUSINESS

  19..  City Operating and Capital Improvement Program Revised Budget - Fiscal Year
  2024/25
City Council Agenda  4  June 25, 2024
   Recommended Action: (1) Adopt Resolution 24-XX Adopting a Revised Budget for the City
  of Mission Viejo for Fiscal Year 2024/25 and Appropriating Funds for Fiscal Year 2024/25;
  and (2) adopt Resolution 24-XX Amending the City's Salary Schedule to be Effective July 1,
  2024 and Authorized Position Schedule to be Effective July 6, 2024.

  20.  Employment Agreement for Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services, Jerry
  M. Hill

  Recommended Action: (1) Adopt Resolution 24-XX, Approving an Employment
  Agreement with Mr. Jerry M. Hill as Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services for
  the City of Mission Viejo, and (2) authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on behalf of
  the City.

  21.  Annual Review of Residential and Commercial Integrated Waste Management Rates

  Recommended Action: (1) Receive and file the annual CPI adjustment to trash rates; and (2)
  Approve Waste Management’s request for an extraordinary rate increase due to unforeseen
  increases in labor costs.

  MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, COMMITTEE REPORTS AND ACTIONS

  22.  Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) Report

  Recommended Action: Receive written report.

  CITY MANAGER REPORTS

  CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS

  COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

  23.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended ~ AB1234

  Recommended Action: Receive reports.

  Council Member Bucknum

  Council Member Goodell

  Council Member Vasquez

  Mayor Pro Tem Ruesch

  Mayor Kelley

City Council Agenda  5  June 25, 2024
 Adjournment to July 9, 2024, at 5:00 PM

At the hour of 9:30 p.m., the City Council will review the remaining agenda items and make a
decision regarding the items to be considered before the 11:00 p.m. adjournment and the items to
be continued to the next meeting.

  NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC

  Supplemental material received after the posting of the Agenda

Any supplemental writings or documents distributed to a majority of the City Council regarding any item
on this Agenda, after the posting of the Agenda, will be available for public review in the City Clerk’s
Office located at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California, during normal business hours. In addition,
such writings or documents will be made available on the City’s web site at http://cityofmissionviejo.org/
and will be available for public review at the respective meeting.

If you have any questions regarding any item of business on the Agenda for this meeting, please contact
City Clerk’s Office staff at (949) 470-3052 or by email – cityclerk@cityofmissionviejo.org.

  Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (949) 470-3052 (voice) or the California Relay Service at
least 48 hours prior to the meeting. If you have special accessibility needs, please notify the City Clerk’s
office as soon as possible before the meeting so that reasonable arrangements for accessibility can be
made.

City Council Agenda  6  June 25, 2024
